div.div:
AUTHORITY AND DELIVERY
Partner master in OLAP controls recipients, opt-in and language. Shared execution login is separate from initiating partner identity.
IG delivery observes its inbound messaging window; fallback also requires opt-in. Partners collect face-to-face and forward borrower drafts themselves.
